body: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
plain_description: AutoGPT gets you 10 hours back every week by turning plain-English descriptions into AI agents that do the work. Describe what you want — daily briefs, sales research, campaign drafts, support replies — and AutoGPT builds the agent, runs it, and reports back. Use the managed cloud platform with zero setup or self-host with a single command.
technical_description: AutoGPT is an open-source platform for building, deploying, and running autonomous AI agents that execute multi-step workflows. The architecture comprises a Python backend (FastAPI) and PostgreSQL database, a React/TypeScript frontend with a drag-and-drop visual agent builder, and a distributed agent runtime that orchestrates execution across modular block nodes. Agents connect to 45+ integrated platforms (Gmail, Slack, GitHub, Notion, HubSpot, etc.) and hundreds of AI models through provider APIs. Execution supports on-demand, scheduled, and webhook-triggered modes with human-in-the-loop review. Deployment options include a managed cloud service with built-in model access and credentials, or self-hosted via Docker with bring-your-own infrastructure and API keys.
title: AutoGPT
